title.zh: 【Midnight 推出跨链隐私交易功能 Nightmode】
title.en: 【Midnight 推出跨链隐私交易功能 Nightmode】

current_state.zh: Midnight Network launched Nightmode, which uses source-chain MPC vault contracts and multi-chain shielded pools to let users trade, swap, or stake native assets on public protocols like Uniswap while keeping identity and wallet information private, with zero-knowledge selective disclosure available for regulatory compliance.
current_state.en: Midnight Network launched Nightmode, which uses source-chain MPC vault contracts and multi-chain shielded pools to let users trade, swap, or stake native assets on public protocols like Uniswap while keeping identity and wallet information private, with zero-knowledge selective disclosure available for regulatory compliance.
